messages:
mira: Ok team, starting the green->blue drain for router group A in us-west-2 now. Targeting 10% increments with 2m observation windows. Keep an eye on 5xx and tail latency.
deploy-bot: [deploy] Routing update initiated: group-A weights -> green:90% blue:10% (id: rtr-202603)
aj: Noted. I'll watch the canary traces. Triggering slow-query alert subscription.
sasha: Heads up — sessions for the old cookie_name are sticky. If we switch clients may keep hitting green for ~1-3m depending on TTL.
mira: Good call. Plan: after first 2 increments we'll flip Set-Cookie header to new cookie_name=v2 so new sessions land on blue. Old sessions will drain naturally.
kevin: If we see >1% 5xx during any window we stop the shift and rollback to previous weights. Lia, are you on call for rollback? :eyes:
lia-oncall: Oncall here. If we need rollback ping with "rollback now" and I'll execute the fallback playbook.
deploy-bot: healthcheck: /internal/health group-A blue -> 200 OK, 0.0% error over last 5m
aj: I'm seeing a 95th p99 spike on completion latency for embeddings route during the last minute, ~220ms -> 480ms. Might be batching behavior with blue variant.
mira: Copy. Hold next increment. aj, can you paste the span ids? We'll correlate with runtime metrics.
aj: span ids: 0x7a3c,0x7a3d. Also posting a quick curl to check router stats:
```
curl -sS http://router-usw2.internal/metrics?group=A | grep 'weight'
# output: group_A_green_weight 90\ngroup_A_blue_weight 10
```
sasha: If we need to pin traffic for a client, we can use the header X-Redwood-Test: blue. Might be useful for manual repro.
mira: Let's wait 90s. If 5xx stays <0.2% and latency trend stabilizes, we'll move to 30/70.
lia-oncall: Ready for rollback steps. FYI have the playbook open: /runbooks/release/rollback-router-group-A.md
kevin: Also make sure dedicated cache invalidation runs after cookie flip. I sent a purge job to edge-cache with id purge-4821.
mira: OK small update: after 90s metrics look steady. aj, you still see the p99 elevated?
aj: p99 trending down to 330ms, errors 0.08%. Proceed to 30/70.
mira: deploy-bot execute next shift.
deploy-bot: [deploy] Routing update: group-A weights -> green:70% blue:30% (id: rtr-202603-step2)
kevin: Monitoring load on blue hosts only. No allocation spikes.
sasha: After we hit 50% we flip Set-Cookie for new sessions. I'll prepare the config patch: /configs/router/set-cookie-v2.json
mira: Thanks. If anything goes wrong we stop and lia will run rollback. Keep this thread as single source for decisions. :thumbsup:
lia-oncall: 👍 will stand by.
mira: Update: reached 50/50, cookie flip deployed, new session cookie present on 200s. Continuing to 90/10 -> final swap in 10m.
aj: No regressions observed, rolling forward.
kevin: After final swap I'll trigger drain of old green instances (grace period 5m).
mira: final note: tagging release notes with router change id rtr-202603 and adding postmortem checklist to release ticket. Good job everyone."
